professionalSummary.text: Manages the service-desk team and its SLA performance.
professionalSummary.witness: Service delivery manager at Stratus Harbour Hosting from 2019 to 2024, managing a service desk of nine analysts on two shifts against the customer SLAs, with a duty manager on each shift reporting to the candidate.

experienceHighlights.text: Has owned a support outsourcing contract, including the renewal.
experienceHighlights.witness: Named in the contract schedule as contract owner for the out-of-hours support outsourcing agreement; negotiated and signed the 2023 renewal within the delegated authority set by the chief operating officer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Leads the major-incident process and customer communications.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran the major-incident bridge for priority-one incidents and sent customer status updates every 30 minutes until resolution, then chaired the post-incident review within five working days.

skills.text: Presents monthly service reviews to customers.
skills.witness: Presented monthly service reviews to the eight largest customers, covering SLA attainment, incident trends and open problem records, and agreed actions with each customer's IT lead.
